scope.summary: Implement automatic page-number markers that resolve to the current page's section number wherever placed (parent page, running header, TOC), plus a last-page-number marker (section or document scope) resolving 'page X of Y' constructs; numbering markers are text-variable records (MT-177) resolved at composition time. Implement content-derived running headers/footers: a header/footer field pulls the first or last on-page text carrying a chosen paragraph or character style (dictionary-style headers), with delete-trailing-punctuation and change-case options; running headers resolve per page against the composed StudioTextStory and MUST update as content reflows.
acceptance_criteria: section-aware page/last-page markers; content-derived running headers with all options, updating on reflow
proof_targets: marker resolution runtime; running-header reflow-update test
expected_tests: live: page-number marker resolves current section number on parent/header/TOC; last-page marker resolves X-of-Y
test: running header pulls first/last styled on-page text with delete-punctuation + change-case, updates on reflow

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Page numbers & running headers

risk_if_missed: No live page numbers or running heads; long documents cannot number/label pages.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
